boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain New Jersey Institute of Technology
boards.description: Ten currently listed Newark food destinations with late service, selected for straightforward under-21 dining options near NJIT.

cards.title: Palace Fried Chicken & Gyro
cards.subtitle: 1034 Broad St, Newark
cards.notes: Check the Broad Street location’s current menu before heading out; its official site lists food service until 2 AM every day.
cards.short_summary: A Broad Street counter-service option with nightly hours listed to 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Palace Fried Chicken & Gyro lists its address as 1034 Broad St, Newark and hours of 8 AM–2 AM Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 8:00 AM–2:00 AM Monday–Sunday; confirm availability before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Jones Street
cards.subtitle: 52 Jones St, Newark
cards.notes: Use the location page to check the day’s drive-thru schedule; it currently lists closing as late as 3 AM Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A chain option with official late drive-thru hours near University Heights.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-thru hours until 2 AM Sunday–Wednesday and until 3 AM Thursday–Saturday at 52 Jones St.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru service to 2 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 3 AM Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Market Street
cards.subtitle: 198 Market St, Newark
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order through the store page; its posted restaurant hours run until 2 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: Pizza, wings, sides, and desserts with a daily 2 AM listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official page for 198 Market St lists delivery and carryout restaurant hours of 10 AM–2 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours through 2:00 AM daily; delivery availability may vary.

cards.title: IHOP on Bergen Street
cards.subtitle: 109 Bergen St, Newark
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, takeout, or delivery from the listed options; the official location page states that the restaurant is open 24 hours daily.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours diner-format option with dine-in and takeout services listed.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official Newark page lists 109 Bergen St and shows the restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day.

cards.title: Sun Island Plate
cards.subtitle: 820 South Orange Ave, Newark
cards.notes: Confirm ordering details directly with the restaurant, then use its listed dine-in, takeout, or delivery choices for a meal at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A Jamaican restaurant that states it operates 24/7 in Newark.
cards.evidence_claim: Sun Island Plate’s official site identifies its Newark location at 820 South Orange Ave and states that it is open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Official site states “OPEN 24/7” and describes dine-in, takeout, and delivery options.

cards.title: Pizza 2000 on Court Street
cards.subtitle: 19 Court St, Newark
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own ordering page for its current menu and pickup details; it posts service from 11 AM until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Court Street pizza shop with an official 2 AM closing listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza 2000’s official ordering site lists 19 Court St, Newark and hours of 11:00 AM–2:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering site lists daily hours of 11:00 AM–2:00 AM.

cards.title: Andros Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 6 Wilson Ave, Newark
cards.notes: Check its direct contact page before making the trip; the restaurant posts 24-hour operation and provides a phone number for confirmation.
cards.short_summary: A Wilson Avenue restaurant whose official page lists round-the-clock hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Andros Restaurant’s official contact page lists 6 Wilson Ave, Newark and says it is open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official contact page lists Monday–Sunday, open 24 hours.

cards.title: Motto Juice Bar
cards.subtitle: 58 Norfolk St, Newark
cards.notes: Plan this as a Thursday-to-Saturday stop: the restaurant’s ordering page lists smoothies, bowls, pasta, burgers, and 11 PM closing those nights.
cards.short_summary: A Norfolk Street juice bar and food counter posted until 11 PM on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Motto Juice Bar’s direct ordering page lists 58 Norfolk St and hours until 11 PM Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists 4:00 PM–11:00 PM Thursday–Saturday; it is closed Sunday and Monday.

cards.title: Masala Cafe on Academy Street
cards.subtitle: 27 Academy St, Newark
cards.notes: Order ahead or stop in before its posted close; the restaurant’s own site lists Indian and halal food service until 11 PM Monday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An Academy Street Indian café with a current 11 PM weekday-and-Saturday listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Masala Cafe’s official site lists 27 Academy St, Newark and business hours of 11 AM–11 PM Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11:00 AM–11:00 PM Monday–Saturday and closed Sunday.

cards.title: 1Click Caribbean Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 901 18th Ave, Newark
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s order link or call ahead before visiting; its official site lists the same 11 PM close for every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: A Newark Caribbean-food destination with daily service posted through 11 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: 1Click Caribbean Cuisine’s official site lists 901 18th Ave, Newark and hours of 7 AM–11 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 7:00 AM–11:00 PM Sunday through Saturday.
